name: Applications of differentiation tangents and optimization

questions.q: What is the equation of the tangent to the curve y = 3x² - 4x + 1 at the point where x = 2?
Find the x-coordinate of the stationary point for the curve y = x³ - 3x² - 9x + 5.
Determine the nature of the stationary point at x = 3 for the curve y = x³ - 3x² - 9x + 5 using the second derivative test.
A particle moves in a straight line such that its displacement s meters from a fixed point at time t seconds is given by s = t³ - 6t² + 9t. Find the acceleration when t = 4 seconds.
Find the rate of change of the area of a circle with respect to its radius r when r = 5 cm.
What is the gradient of the normal to the curve y = 4x³ - 2x at the point where x = 1?
Find the values of x for which the curve y = 2x³ - 9x² + 12x is increasing.
A rectangular garden is to be fenced using 40 meters of fencing against a long straight wall. What is the maximum possible area of the garden?
Find the equation of the normal to the curve y = x² - 5x + 6 at the point where x = 2.
At what point on the curve y = x³ is the gradient equal to 27?
The displacement of a particle is given by s = 4 sin(2t). Find its maximum velocity.
Find the second derivative of f(x) = x⁴ × eˣ.
Find the x-coordinate of the point of inflection on the curve y = x³ - 6x² + 11x - 6.
An open box with a square base is to be made from 108 cm² of sheet metal. What base dimension maximizes the volume?
If y = ln(3x² + 1), find dy/dx.
Find the smallest value of the function f(x) = 2x³ - 15x² + 36x for x in the interval [1, 5].

A ladder 10 meters long rests against a vertical wall. If the bottom of the ladder slides away from the wall at a rate of 0.5 m/s, how fast is the top sliding down when the bottom is 6 meters from the wall?
Find the gradient of the curve y = e²ˣ × cos(x) at x = 0.
For what range of values of x is the curve y = 2x³ - 9x² + 12x - 3 concave downwards?
Water is poured into a conical tank at a rate of 8 cm³/s. The height of the tank is 12 cm and the radius of the top is 6 cm. How fast is the water level rising when the water is 4 cm deep?
Find the absolute maximum value of f(x) = x³ - 3x + 2 on the interval [0, 2].
If x² + y² = 25, find dy/dx at the point (3, -4).
Find the critical numbers of the function f(x) = x²/³ × (x - 4).
The cost function for producing x units of an item is C(x) = 0.01x³ - 0.6x² + 150x + 1000. Find the marginal cost when x = 20.
Find the angle that the tangent to the curve y = x² at the point (2, 4) makes with the positive x-axis.
Find the linear approximation of f(x) = √x at x = 100, and use it to estimate √102.
Find the value of k for which the curve y = x³ + kx² + 3x + 1 has a stationary point at x = 1.
A cylindrical can is to hold 1000 cm³ of liquid. What radius minimizes the total surface area?
Find the maximum vertical distance between the line y = x and the parabola y = x² - x for 0 < x < 1.
Given y = tan(3x), find the value of the second derivative at x = 0.
Find the coordinates of the stationary points of y = x × e⁻ˣ.
If the displacement of an object is s(t) = t⁴ - 4t³, determine the total distance traveled from t = 0 to t = 5.
Determine the interval on which the function f(x) = x / (x² + 1) is decreasing.
Find the slope of the tangent line to the curve x³ + y³ = 6xy at the point (3, 3).
Find the maximum area of a rectangle inscribed in a semicircle of radius R.
If f(x) = arctan(2x), find f'(0.5).
Find the value of c that satisfies the Mean Value Theorem for f(x) = x³ - x on the interval [0, 2].
Find the limits of the rate of change of y = 3 cos(x) - 4 sin(x).
A Norman window consists of a rectangle surmounted by a semicircle. If the perimeter is 12 meters, find the radius of the semicircle that maximizes the area of the window.
Determine the value of a such that the function f(x) = x³ + ax² + 9x has no stationary points.
